name: Max Mara
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $462 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's camel and wool coats from about $1,900 to $4,500, plus suiting, knitwear, dresses and bags, sold through its own boutiques, site and department stores.
origin: Founded in Reggio Emilia, Italy in 1951 by Achille Maramotti.

quote.q: We have the fashion conscious, not fashion victims, in mind – those with a personality, who make conscious choices.

opview: “We have the fashion conscious, not fashion victims, in mind – those with a personality, who make conscious choices.” — Max Mara Fashion Group (house), Overview, maxmarafashiongroup.com

facts_read.source: brand site; maxmarafashiongroup.com overview; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

T-shirt.lp: Cotton and modal jersey T-shirt ('S Max Mara)

Sweater.hp: Yak yarn sweater with scarf detail ('S Max Mara)

Dress.lp: Short sleeveless cotton denim dress ('S Max Mara)

price_read.sublines: Max Mara, 'S Max Mara, Max Mara Studio, Max Mara The Cube, Max Mara Accessori (shoes); EXCLUDED: Weekend Max Mara and Sportmax (sister banners with their own US stores, sold on the same site), Runway and Accessori Runway pieces

doors.note: site maxmara.com (us.maxmara.com/store-locator redirects to store.maxmara.com); 23 published US Max Mara stores: 13 direct boutiques and 3 franchise boutiques (Costa Mesa, Bellevue, Palo Alto; operator 'franchise partner', flagged) as own doors, and 7 Bloomingdale's and Saks listings (feed type CD, no sign of a branded shop on the pages) as ruled 10 Oct: counters, counted nowhere; the feed holds 5 more Max Mara US records the locator does not publish (3 Bloomingdale's studio or cube shops, Aventura Bloomingdale's, and an outlet at Woodbury), held in out_of_scope_doors.csv (ruled 10 Oct: not counted until the locator shows them); the shared feed also lists 32 US records for sister brands (Weekend Max Mara, Marina Rinaldi, Marella, MAX&Co.), not returned (sister banners are separate brands); plus 7 department-store counter row(s), kept in return_doors.csv and counted nowhere; ruled 10 Oct: the 3 Bloomingdale's studio/cube records count as concessions and Woodbury as an outlet (in the feed, not on the public locator); Aventura stays a counter

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 from 304 women's clothing styles (10-digit model stem of the 13-digit product code, colour collapsed), collected by scrolling 13 categor

tech_evidence.names: NONE (water-repellent plain-weave and canvas claims without a named fabric; camel-wool padding on some puffers)
tech_evidence.share: 0% named; about 12% of sampled styles carry a water-repellent claim

craft_evidence.owned: yes, stated by the house: Manifatture di San Maurizio, 'a manufacturing plant located just outside Reggio Emilia, where over 100,000 coats and jackets are produced annually' (mm-world page); no photo
craft_evidence.makers: the coat plant is named on the house's editorial page; product pages name no maker
craft_evidence.madein: 0% in product page text read (none of 80 sampled PDPs states a country)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated: archival prints 'from 1951'; Reggio Emilia (Collezione Maramotti) named on the mm-world page
craft_evidence.process: partial — the coat plant's savoir-faire is celebrated, not described step by step
craft_evidence.reasoning: The house's own pages name a manufacturing plant, Manifatture di San Maurizio outside Reggio Emilia, and give an annual output of over 100,000 coats and jackets. That is owned, named and placed making, but it covers coats and jackets, not the whole range, and the product pages state no country or maker. A 4, not a 5.
